_1_summary: Tuned attention predictor. Test, mean of 4 seeds: regret_p50 0.2279+-0.004, gain 0.1396+-0.005, top5 0.2670, rho_clip 0.4069, delta_clip -1.45, modal_cell_frac 0.184 over 49 cells. The shipped settings.json scores 0.3032 / 0.0534 / 0.2513 / 0.008 / -4.17 / 1.000 over 1 cell.
_2_USE_ATTN_RESIDUAL: The single decisive change. Without it the block returns the attention output alone, which is a convex combination of value vectors and therefore a function of the image only; the prompts, being queries, can influence it solely by tilting a softmax. Turning it off reproduces the best-constant-cell baseline exactly (regret 0.3045).
_3_PREDICTION_SPACE: deltas, not residuals. Because phi is concave, argmax_k phi(mean_k) != argmax_k mean(phi_k); a residual model with weak per-image signal falls back to the former, which is the (0.0, 0.0) corner at delta_clip -4.46. deltas falls back to cell 57 at -1.35.
_4_column_losses: PSNR_LOSS_WEIGHT / CLIP_LOSS_WEIGHT are per-column MSE on the delta surfaces, applied before phi scalarizes them. They are the only terms that supervise the CLIP head; with both at 0, rho_clip goes negative, reproducing the original anti-correlated head.
_5_PATCH_SIZE: Inert while IMG_EMB_SOURCE is 'clip' (no VAE tokens are built). Kept defined so the value is right if the source is switched back to 'vae' or 'vae+clip'; 8 was best there, though patch size barely matters once the residual is on.
_6_PHI_ALPHA: The canonical scoreboard, unchanged. TRAIN_PHI_ALPHA / TRAIN_PHI_WEIGHTS reshape the loss only; both null here because lowering alpha buys regret at the cost of delta_clip, and raising CLIP's training weight monotonically wrecks regret.
_7_alternatives: Same base, elsewhere on the measured frontier: CLIP_LOSS_WEIGHT 2 gives regret 0.2214 but rho_clip only 0.2524; TRAIN_PHI_ALPHA 0.5 gives top1 0.0753 at delta_clip -1.97. This config clears every anti-collapse and CLIP gate by the widest margin at statistically tied regret.
_8_if_top1_matters_more: Set RANKING_LOSS_TOP_K to 5. Top1 0.0638 -> 0.0751 and top5 0.2670 -> 0.2908, both above the MLP, at identical regret -- but delta_clip goes -1.45 -> -2.27, rho_clip 0.407 -> 0.368, and distinct cells 49 -> 24. Every route to higher top1 that was tried cost CLIP the same way; the top1-optimal constant cell is the high-PSNR (0.0, 0.0) corner, so objectives sharpened at the very top of the ranking drift toward it.
